9 is in bold. 'what would you like to say to my daughter that you have not said in a text.' she wants it in writing. in a full sentence. by thursday

effects.subject: A FEW QUESTIONS FOR MY FILE (BRYAN) (BY THURSDAY)
effects.text: Bryan honey, here are my questions, I am posting them where you are sure to see them. 1. Do you eat breakfast? 2. Is the truck insured? 3. Where do you plan to be Friday at 7:53 PM? 4. Is the phone charged? 5. What does your father do for work? (I know. I want to hear you say it.) 6. Do you have a Plan B? 7. What is the name of your drum set? 8. Do you own a coat? 9. What would you like to say to my daughter that you have not said in a text? Please answer in full sentences. Love, Mom. P.S. A polite young man named Josh has informed me this went to EVERYBODY. Hello everybody. Questions 1 through 8 are optional for you. Bryan, they are not optional for you.

choices.say: start w/ 9. write it, dont send it. just see what comes out.
skip 9. whats ur plan for friday. thats the real question.
answer all 9 w/ 'yes ma'am.' it got u thru the casserole.

them: ok i have a quarter. heads garage, tails halftime. flipping. ...
it landed in the kick drum. its in there. i can hear it rolling around inside. i cant flip again w/o taking the head off. is that a sign

choices.say: its a sign u shouldnt let a quarter decide. read me the list instead.
its a sign. now make a plan like a person. what times r we dealing w/?

thats the longest thing ive written that wasnt a bulletin about a show. her mom asked for it so technically i owe it to her mom first. is that weird. its weird

choices.say: its not weird. she asked, u answered. send it to her mom. she'll know what to do with it.
do the logistics first. an answer isnt worth much if ur in the wrong place.

them: ok. i sent her 9 'yes ma'ams.' all 9. she'll know. i also answered 'is the truck insured' w/ yes ma'am and its not. my dad says 'in spirit.' i just lied to a school employee 9 times

choices.say: go back. do 3 and 9 for real. the rest can stay yes ma'am.
ask her for help w/ friday. she hates a lie but she loves a plan.

then he said 'kevin is available on the pad' like it was a threat. {you} kevin is ALWAYS available on the pad

effects.text: greg is not moving the set list. a set list is a promise. the closer closes. (drums, usually)

she replied in 40 seconds. 'Bryan honey. Thank you for telling me the truth. I have a phone tree and a laminator. I will call Greg's mother. effects.text: bryan is in the 4th row. he counted her kicks. the 4th one is the hard one. he knows. he is here.

effects.subject: A REMINDER: STATIC PROPHECY BEGINS AT 6:00 PM SHARP (FRIDAY)

effects.subject: STATIC PROPHECY: LIVE FROM THE PARKING LOT (GATE 3) (HISTORIC)
